categories.main_business_segments: Xiamen XTC New Energy Materials Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of new energy battery materials. Its main product lines include lithium cobalt oxide (LCO), ternary materials (NCM), lithium iron phosphate (LFP), and hydrogen storage alloys. The company serves sectors such as 3C consumer electronics, electric vehicles, and energy storage, with a focus on high-performance cathode materials and hydrogen energy materials.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies including high-voltage cobalt oxide synthesis, co-precipitation techniques for precursors, high-nickel cathode material synthesis, and advanced surface treatment for high-power materials. It also focuses on solid-state battery materials and solid electrolytes, leveraging innovations in ion conduction and interface stability. Production methods emphasize co-precipitation, doping, coating, and wet chemical processes to enhance energy density, safety, and cycle life.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading battery manufacturers in the 3C electronics and new energy vehicle sectors, including domestic and international companies. The company targets markets for smartphones, laptops, tablets, electric vehicles (pure electric, hybrid, plug-in hybrid), energy storage systems, and hydrogen energy applications. It maintains strategic partnerships with top-tier battery producers and automotive OEMs.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with production facilities in Xiamen, Sanming, Ningde, Ya'an, and Fuquan. The company has established a wholly-owned subsidiary in Germany to expand its presence in the European market. Its sales cover domestic and international markets, with increasing exports and overseas project developments, including a joint venture in France.
categories.supply_chain_position: XTC New Energy Materials operates upstream and midstream in the new energy battery supply chain, focusing on the production of cathode materials and hydrogen storage alloys. It procures raw materials such as cobalt, nickel, lithium, and manganese salts from strategic suppliers and joint ventures, ensuring stable supply and quality. The company supplies these materials directly to battery manufacturers downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in high-voltage and high-power cobalt oxide and ternary materials, high-nickel and ultra-high-nickel cathodes, lithium iron phosphate with improved low-temperature performance, sodium-ion cathode materials, lithium supplement materials, and solid-state battery components. It invests heavily in innovation, holding numerous patents and focusing on product differentiation, safety, and energy density improvements. International expansion and advanced manufacturing systems are also strategic priorities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of battery materials, including cobalt oxide, ternary cathode materials, lithium iron phosphate, and hydrogen storage alloys. The company employs a cost-plus pricing model based on raw material costs plus processing fees, with customized production to meet specific client requirements. It also gains income from equity investments and government subsidies related to technology development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: XTC New Energy Materials is a leading domestic player in cobalt oxide and ternary cathode materials, holding a top market share in cobalt oxide globally. The ternary materials market is more fragmented, but the company is among the front-runners in high-voltage and high-power segments. It competes with major battery material suppliers and maintains strong technological and quality advantages. Its hydrogen storage alloy business is also a market leader domestically.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 17.31 billion, a 39.79% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 527 million, down 52.93%. Despite short-term declines due to market and raw material price fluctuations, the company has a solid asset base of RMB 13.48 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D. Cash flow from operations improved significantly to RMB 2.58 billion, reflecting better working capital management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-performance, high-safety, and cost-effective battery materials tailored to customer needs. Its proprietary high-voltage cobalt oxide and high-nickel ternary materials offer superior energy density and fast-charging capabilities, supporting advanced applications like drones and electric vehicles. It differentiates through integrated R&D and production, strong patent portfolio, stable quality control, and strategic partnerships, positioning itself as a technology-driven supplier with a comprehensive product matrix.
